Name: Undercut Hairstyles Galore
Author: inmognito
Description:
A content patcher mod, modifying some of the existing farmer hairstyles to incorporate an undercut.

More hairstyles to follow.

Now with added config menu, allowing you to switch off any of the undercut styles if you prefer their vanilla versions.

[b]Note: [/b]I do take requests, if there's a particular hairstyle you want adapted.

Manifest.Name: (CP) Undercut Hairstyles galore!
Manifest.Description: Modifies a number of vanilla hairstyles to add undercuts to them
Manifest.Author: Inmognito
